messages:
kevin_sales: FYI — Cascade (FinServ) just asked for a VPC/on-prem private deployment in Canada gov region. They want timeline and a checklist for compliance and networking. Can we triage?

maria_product: thanks — can you drop their must-haves? data residency, required SLA, any HW constraints?

kevin_sales: copied from their email: 1) full data residency in Canada, 2) integration with their KMS (Thales HSM), 3) audit logs forwarded to Splunk, 4) PCI-related workloads, 5) expected peak qps ~ 200 r/s, 6) prefer H100s but open to A100 if perf ok. They want a 3-4 week rollout if feasible.

sam_engineering: quick gut check: perf on A100 vs H100 depends on model + quantization. For Llama-2-70B we need H100 for headroom at 200 r/s unless heavy quant + aggressive batching. Need to know model family + token length P95.

aj_devops: networking checklist to start: VPN/Direct Connect or private peering, CIDR plan, NAT/Egress policy, FQDNs to allow, TLS termination (client or our side), MTU settings. Also need access window for installers and bastion jumpbox IP whitelist.

olga_support: from support/compliance: they require 1y audit log retention, SIEM forwarding, and role-based access control integration (SAML + SCIM). Also clarify whether logs can leave the VPC — they said 'no'.

maria_product: OK consolidation — we need to return a feasibility note and a dependency checklist for Sales + Support to collect. Draft timeline options: Minimal (2–4w) — if customer provides HW + networking + KMS certs + infra team. Typical (6–8w) — if we provision hardware and run wiring, plus SOC/pen test schedule. Long (10–14w) — if we need procurement + custom HSM integration and shared compliance windows. Thoughts?

sam_engineering: agree. Also list technical blockers: 1) HSM integration (PKCS#11) — needs certs and dev access; 2) NFS / shared disk for model artifacts (or S3 gateway) — need throughput numbers; 3) K8s version & CRI + GPU driver compatibility (we require >=1.25, nvidia-driver >=535); 4) kernel settings for hugepages if using Triton-like runtime.

aj_devops: add: required ports: 443 out, 10250 for kube, 9090/9100 for metrics (if customer allows), and optional peering for cross-account S3. Egress billing / NAT gateway needs signoff.

kevin_sales: I'm going to ask them for model list + expected context length P95 and whether they can allow logs to be forwarded (within Canada) to Splunk. Also ask for a contact for their infra team and expected maintenance windows.

maria_product: great. Can we put a short intake template so Sales can collect everything in one shot? Suggest:

```
Customer name:
Target region (AZ/City):
On-prem datacenter (yes/no) + contact:
Required models & versions:
P95 context length (tokens):
Peak r/s and burst patterns:
Desired hardware (H100/A100) + tolerance:
KMS/HSM vendor + contact + PKCS#11 details:
Ingress/egress CIDRs + FQDNs to allow:
SIEM / log sink + retention requirements:
SAML/SCIM provider + admin contact:
Compliance certs required (PCI/SOC2/etc):
Maintenance window / blackout periods:
Installation access (bastion IPs) & expected provisioning lead time:
```

sam_engineering: +1. Also add: firewall rules for ephemeral port ranges, and whether they accept our telemetry (cpu/gpu metrics) or need fully zero-trust no-metrics mode.

olga_support: add contact for legal/compliance — they might need DPA amendments and encryption attestations.

maria_product: I will take this and draft a feasibility response. Plan: deliver a short feasibility note by EOD tomorrow with options and a dependency checklist. If they confirm the intake template within 48h, we can commit to the 'Typical' 6–8w path otherwise we default to 10–14w.

kevin_sales: I'll ping them now and copy the template.

deploy-bot: note: upcoming maintenance window on 1749125000 — may affect provisioning timelines in us-east-1 only.

aj_devops: thanks - also flagging procurement lead time for H100: ~6–10 weeks if they're buying, FYI.

maria_product: cool. Action items: kevin -> collect template answers; kevin -> infra contact; sam -> draft HW/perf notes for A100 vs H100 by EOD; aj -> prepare network/cni checklist; olga -> list compliance docs we need. We'll reconvene once we have answers. :thumbsup:
